about.main:
Hello! I am an Argentine programmer with a passion for design and new technologies.
  I've always enjoyed solving problems, and I like to do it with the creative touch that defines me.
  I believe that systems should adapt to people, not the other way around. That's why I focus on creating intuitive, functional, and simple solutions that align with the user's natural behavior while maintaining coherence and flow.
about.studyText:
I believe knowledge expands the limits of what's possible, and I've always sought to learn in order to gain freedom in my creations. This is why I’ve developed skills in different areas that complement each other in the design of comprehensive systems.
  I am currently studying Information Systems Engineering at the Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN) in Buenos Aires.
about.artText:
The way we interact with technology matters. I come from a creative background and have always valued design as a key tool for connecting with people.
  I believe in solutions that not only work well but also make a visual impact and convey intent. My experience with art, writing, and drawing allows me to bring an aesthetic and human perspective to system development, creating experiences that blend functionality with identity.

whatIDo.developmentMainText: Every problem has a solution, and these can be the steps to find yours:
whatIDo.interviewText: To deeply understand the needs, as well as the resources and timelines involved.
whatIDo.designText: Taking into account the established requirements, various design options are proposed, with easy access to section modification.
whatIDo.resourceText: All necessary content is gathered and processed.
whatIDo.developmentText: Now, it's time to program from functionality to aesthetics to make it real.
whatIDo.maintenanceText: If necessary, proper maintenance will be performed.
whatIDo.designMainText: My approach to design is based on abstracting the client's main concepts to leverage their advantages in the digital format, aiming to maintain coherence between elements and forms. I use standout pieces in the industry to build a unique and refreshing user experience.
whatIDo.brandMainText: I have the knowledge to develop brand evolution or creation, primarily focusing on digital usage across new media, as well as internal use and print, seeking a versatile design adaptable to all needs.
whatIDo.imageMainText: Images are the user's first real contact with us, which is why I offer photography and editing services.
whatIDo.draftingMainText: Much of the content consumed is written, so I can participate in writing, proofreading, or editing texts, as well as providing simple translations to English or Italian.
whatIDo.animationMainText: In today's industry, motion is predominant. In addition to developing visible effects based on user interaction, I can implement provided animations as well as develop my own with a simple style.
